scope: GitHub Actions correctness and cost for tension-atoi/calix
summary: CI had been failing for reasons outside the source tree. The job is now pinned to one Arch snapshot and runs the same gate as the pre-push hook; the fix was proven in archlinux:latest locally before any push.

root_causes.symptom: build.zig:75:11: error: no field named 'args' in struct 'Build'
root_causes.cause: archlinux:latest installs zig from pacman; on 2026-10-12 that became 0.17 while the tree targets 0.16

root_causes.symptom: fatal linker error: unhandled relocation type R_X86_64_PC64 at offset 0x1c, in crt1.o:.sframe
root_causes.cause: the upstream ziglang.org 0.16.0 tarball links with its own linker, which does not handle .sframe; the distro build links system LLD 21 and does. Reproduced on the host: the upstream binary fails where the distro binary passes

root_causes.symptom: ld.lld: error: unable to find library -lxkbcommon / -lxkbcommon-x11
root_causes.cause: ci.yml never installed libxkbcommon or libxkbcommon-x11; pre-existing, hidden behind the compiler failure

fix.unit: dated Arch userland snapshot, not a compiler binary

verification.note: replay stages a git-archive export, so ignored paths (vendor/, target/, zig-out/) cannot make it pass

deviations: The host reports 1386 PackageManager tests; the pinned container reports 1388. Both exceed the floor; the difference was not investigated in this run.
